charts.title: Customer Segmentation by Region
charts.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS count FROM croma_customers_dataset GROUP BY region ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 8

charts.title: Top 8 Products by Revenue
charts.sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM croma_order_items_dataset GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 8

charts.sql: SELECT season, COUNT(order_id) AS customer_activity FROM croma_orders_dataset GROUP BY season ORDER BY customer_activity DESC LIMIT 8

dashboards.summary: Centralized view combining the most important metrics across 5 focus area(s): Customer Behavior, Product Performance, Order Fulfillment, Geographical Insights, Seasonal Trends. Each section below has its own dedicated dashboard with deeper detail.

kpi_insights.Number of Regular Customers: With 27,599 regular customers, the company has a substantial base of loyal patrons.
kpi_insights.Total Revenue: The total revenue of 14,609,390,523.80 aligns with the product performance theme.
kpi_insights.Average Rating: An average rating of 3.94 indicates a generally positive customer experience.
kpi_insights.Cancelled Orders Percentage: The 5.01% cancellation rate is low, suggesting efficient order management.

chart_insights.Customer Segmentation by Region: The West and South regions dominate with 13,400 and 11,649 customers, respectively, highlighting regional preferences.
chart_insights.Top 8 Products by Revenue: PRD00068 leads with 386,008,799.40, showing that a few key products significantly drive revenue.
chart_insights.Cancelled Orders by Channel: Online channels account for 3,714 cancellations, more than double the 2,295 from in-store, indicating a higher risk of cancellations online.

dashboards.title: Customer Behavior
dashboards.focus: Analyze customer segmentation and behavior across different regions and time periods.

kpis.title: Number of Regular Customers
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM croma_customers_dataset WHERE customer_segment = 'Regular'

kpis.title: Average Age of Customers
kpis.sql: SELECT AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM croma_customers_dataset

kpis.title: Customer Acquisition Rate
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM croma_customers_dataset WHERE customer_since_date >= '2022-01-01') AS total_customers, (COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM croma_customers_dataset WHERE customer_since_date >= '2022-01-01')) * 100 AS rate FROM croma_customers_dataset WHERE customer_since_date >= '2022-01-01'

kpis.title: Average Order Value
kpis.sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM croma_order_items_dataset

charts.title: Customer Segmentation by Region
charts.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS count FROM croma_customers_dataset GROUP BY region ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 8

charts.title: Customer Orders by Season
charts.sql: SELECT season, COUNT(*) AS count FROM croma_orders_dataset GROUP BY season ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 8

charts.title: Customer Reviews by Product Category
charts.sql: SELECT sub_category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM croma_reviews_dataset JOIN croma_products_dataset ON croma_reviews_dataset.product_id = croma_products_dataset.product_id GROUP BY sub_category HAVING count > 10

charts.title: Customer Orders by Month
charts.sql: SELECT month_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM croma_orders_dataset JOIN croma_date_dim ON croma_orders_dataset.order_date = croma_date_dim.date GROUP BY month_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 8

charts.title: Top 10 Cities by Customer Count
charts.sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS count FROM croma_customers_dataset GROUP BY city ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

dashboards.summary: The data reveals a diverse customer base with a significant concentration in the West and South regions, and a high number of regular customers. The average order value is notably high, indicating premium purchases.

kpi_insights.Number of Regular Customers: With 27,599 regular customers, the company has a substantial base of loyal patrons.
kpi_insights.Customer Acquisition Rate: The acquisition rate of 23,981 suggests a steady growth in customer base.
kpi_insights.Average Order Value: The average order value of 60,769.66 indicates a focus on high-value transactions.

chart_insights.Customer Segmentation by Region: The West and South regions dominate with 13,400 and 11,649 customers, respectively, highlighting regional preferences.
chart_insights.Customer Orders by Season: Post-Monsoon/Festive season sees the highest order volume, with 38,727 orders, indicating strong seasonal trends.
chart_insights.Customer Reviews by Product Category: Mid-range products receive the highest reviews, with 5,752, suggesting a strong market for mid-tier offerings.
chart_insights.Customer Orders by Month: October and November see the highest order volumes, with 19,599 and 19,128 orders, respectively, pointing to a strong holiday season.
chart_insights.Top 10 Cities by Customer Count: Pune leads with 1,716 customers, followed closely by Vadodara, Chandigarh, Nagpur, and Kanpur, indicating regional hotspots.

dashboards.title: Product Performance
dashboards.focus: Evaluate product sales and customer ratings to identify top-performing items.

kpis.title: Total Revenue
kpis.sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM croma_order_items_dataset

kpis.title: Average Rating
kpis.sql: SELECT AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM croma_reviews_dataset

kpis.title: Customer Satisfaction Rate
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews, SUM(CASE WHEN rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS satisfied_reviews FROM croma_reviews_dataset

charts.title: Top 8 Products by Revenue
charts.sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM croma_order_items_dataset GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 8

charts.title: Average Rating by Category
charts.sql: SELECT sub_category, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM croma_reviews_dataset INNER JOIN croma_products_dataset ON croma_reviews_dataset.product_id = croma_products_dataset.product_id GROUP BY sub_category

charts.title: Heatmap of Rating Distribution by Month and Year
charts.sql: SELECT month_name, year, COUNT(*) AS rating_count FROM croma_reviews_dataset INNER JOIN croma_date_dim ON croma_reviews_dataset.review_date = croma_date_dim.date GROUP BY month_name, year

charts.title: Top 8 Cities by Total Revenue
charts.sql: SELECT city, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM croma_order_items_dataset INNER JOIN croma_orders_dataset ON croma_order_items_dataset.order_id = croma_orders_dataset.order_id INNER JOIN croma_customers_dataset ON croma_orders_dataset.customer_id = croma_customers_dataset.customer_id GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 8

dashboards.summary: The product performance data highlights a strong revenue generation, with a few top products driving the majority of sales. The average rating is above 3.9, indicating overall customer satisfaction.

kpi_insights.Total Revenue: The total revenue of 14,609,390,523.80 suggests robust financial performance.
kpi_insights.Average Rating: An average rating of 3.94 indicates a generally positive customer experience.
kpi_insights.Customer Satisfaction Rate: The customer satisfaction rate of 55,574 reflects a high level of customer contentment.

chart_insights.Top 8 Products by Revenue: PRD00068 leads with 386,008,799.40, showing that a few key products significantly drive revenue.
chart_insights.Average Rating by Category: Mirrorless cameras have the highest average rating of 4.02, indicating high customer satisfaction in this category.
chart_insights.Heatmap of Rating Distribution by Month: November consistently shows the highest ratings, with 1,827, suggesting a strong performance in that month.
chart_insights.Top 8 Cities by Total Revenue: Pune is the top revenue generator with 524,905,638.80, indicating a strong local market.

dashboards.title: Order Fulfillment
dashboards.focus: Assess the efficiency of order processing and delivery times across different channels and seasons.

kpis.title: Cancelled Orders Percentage

charts.title: Top 10 Products by Revenue
charts.sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM croma_order_items_dataset JOIN croma_products_dataset ON croma_order_items_dataset.product_id = croma_products_dataset.product_id GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

dashboards.summary: The order fulfillment data indicates a relatively low cancellation rate, with most cancellations occurring through the online channel. The top products by revenue are consistent with the product performance theme, reflecting strong sales performance.
